events.verdict: Roddy (MEM) makes contact with Wood's (DAL) head during the driving shot attempt, affecting his ability to defend.
Bane (MEM) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) firms up over his left foot as he establishes himself in Green's (DAL) path and does not deliver contact during the screen.
Kleber (DAL) turns alongside Bane's (MEM) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Bane (MEM) is retreating his arms into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs with Irving (DAL) during his driving shot attempt.
Irving (DAL) reaches in and makes marginal contact with Bane's (MEM) right arm prior to the release of his pass during the drive.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn

events.verdict: Bane (MEM) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) is imminently exiting the lane within three seconds.
Kleber (DAL) jumps alongside Jackson Jr. (MEM) and marginal body contact occurs during his shot attempt at the basket.
Irving (DAL) avoids making contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) left arm during his shot attempt near the rim.
Brooks (MEM) contests Irving's (DAL) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Kleber (DAL) commits a take foul on Aldama (MEM).
Brooks (MEM) closes-out toward Wood's (DAL) jump shot attempt and is not in a legal guarding position as lower body contact occurs during Wood's follow-through.
Kleber (DAL) makes incidental hand on ball contact with Bane (MEM) while briefly dislodging the ball away from him.
